messages:
alex: Hey people-ops, just finished my first-week travel to SF for orientation. I paid for flight + 2 nights. Can I request an advance or an expedited reimbursement? My bank's tight this week.

maya: Welcome aboard Alex! We can do an expedited reimbursement. Two paths: submit via Ramp (normal flow) or we can push a payroll reimbursement if you need cash before the next Ramp approval window. Upload receipts and tag the expense 'First Week Travel'. Link: https://app.ramp.com/expenses/new

alex: Uploaded PDFs (flight + hotel) but not sure how to tag. The UI only shows broad categories.

maya: In the description field add: First Week Travel; Total: $712.40; Manager: @luis. Then reply here once done and I'll triage for payroll. If you need an actual advance (before any receipts processed) we do a one-time payroll advance but that requires manager + people ops sign-off.

sarah: For future folks: do we cover meals during onboarding or only incidental? I had a few dinners.

maya: We reimburse actual meal receipts for onboarding trips. No flat per diem for first-week moves. If individual meal receipts are under $25 we can group them but still need proof.

alex: Done—tagged and added total $712.40, pinged @luis. Also noted card last 4 digits x1234.

expense-bot: Expense submitted: alex, $712.40, tag: First Week Travel, status: pending manager approval.

luis: Approved for reimbursement. Thanks Alex.

expense-bot: Manager approval recorded. Forwarding to people-ops for expedited processing.

maya: I'll route to payroll. Note timing: if submitted before payroll cut-off (Thu 5pm PT) we can include it in the next payroll run. If missed, payroll can issue a manual ACH within 3 business days—email payroll@redwood.com with subject 'Expedite: [thread link]'. If you need an upfront advance instead, confirm here and include a short reason.

alex: One last thing—do I need to retain physical receipts for tax/audit? I scanned everything.

maya: Keep originals for 90 days in case of audit. Scans are fine for submission. Save originals in Drive folder 'Reimbursements/FirstWeek/1999994321'. We'll only ask for originals if audit requests.

alex: Awesome, really appreciate the quick help.

expense-bot: Reimbursement queued for expedited processing. ETA: next payroll or manual ACH if cut-off missed.
